function: The <video> tag is used to embed video content in a document, such as a movie clip or other video streams.

attributes.name: autoplay
attributes.function: Specifies that the video will start playing as soon as it is ready

attributes.name: controls
attributes.function: Specifies that video controls should be displayed (such as a play/pause button etc).

attributes.name: height
attributes.function: Sets the height of the video player

attributes.name: loop
attributes.function: Specifies that the video will start over again, every time it is finished

attributes.name: muted
attributes.function: Specifies that the audio output of the video should be muted

attributes.name: poster
attributes.function: Specifies an image to be shown while the video is downloading, or until the user hits the play button

attributes.name: preload
attributes.function: Specifies if and how the author thinks the video should be loaded when the page loads

attributes.name: src
attributes.function: Specifies the URL of the video file

attributes.name: width
attributes.function: Sets the width of the video player
